items.title: Nepal cannot leave children’s safety to chance when floods strike
items.summary: A photograph published by a national daily shows a student at Bageshwari Secondary School in Baireni, Dhading, searching through a mud-caked schoolbag. It was taken on August 31, five days after the Bhotekoshi flood, with dozens of other bags abandoned nearby. The caption says no more, and I will not invent more. items.title: Bhotekoshi flood displaced 777 students. Nepal plans five-year school recovery
items.summary: Of the 57 educational institutions assessed in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts, 28 were damaged and 15 were completely destroyed.

items.title: Beijing’s security concerns cloud Nepal’s push to reopen Tatopani
items.summary: Flood damage to Rasuwagadhi and the high cost of Korala leave the Sindhupalchok crossing vital to Nepal’s trade with China, but Beijing remains reluctant to reopen it over concerns about Tibet.
